During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the '''Holy Advisor''' to the [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Gascon]] was a corrupt [[Gender/Legends|man]] who gained both power and wealth from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] prior to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Following Palpatine's death, the [[Holy Advisor]] had fallen out of favor with the weak-willed [[Unidentified King of Gascon|King]] of Gascon and the pro-[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of Gascon, [[Marilla]], had the ear of the King. In order to regain the favor of the King and encourage him to support the Empire that had benefited him, he intended to prove that the Queen had been unfaithful, engaging in an affair with the [[Prime Minister (Demigue)|Prime Minister]] of the distant planet [[Demigue]]. His case hinged on a [[Ring/Legends|ring]] she had given the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]], which was originally a gift from her husband and was both unique and quite valuable. When the Queen sent several individuals to recover the ring from Demigue, the Holy Advisor sent many cutthroats and spies to intercept them.
